Targets brain-computer interface applications using non-invasive EEG signals.
Useful as a reference codebase for advanced EEG/BCI model development.

该项目面向非侵入式EEG BCI评估，而非侵入式系统。

It targets non-invasive EEG-based BCI evaluation rather than invasive systems.
Useful for comparing algorithms across standard and extended EEG tasks.

items.title_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI Core SDK Ecosystem
bullets_zh: GitHub仓库yuguoyu123456/ADS1299-Core-SDK描述面向8至64通道硬件的开源ADS1299 EEG/BCI生态。
项目包含MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA参考包、Verilog RTL、PC/移动/Linux集成及Python/MATLAB/R分析流程。
因ADS1299是常见EEG采集前端，该项目与非侵入式BCI相关。
bullets_en: GitHub repository yuguoyu123456/ADS1299-Core-SDK describes an open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem for 8–64 channel hardware.
It includes MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, and Python/MATLAB/R analysis workflows.
Relevant to non-invasive BCI because ADS1299 is a common EEG acquisition front end.
items.brief: ADS1299开源EEG/BCI硬件SDK，覆盖采集、集成与分析流程。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI hardware SDK covering acquisition, integration, analysis, and research workflows.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

Useful for beginners building consumer-grade non-invasive BCI experiments.
